g.text: Preparation/validation failure or missing/mismatched server context: no new save; correct input (integer quantity >= 1) or reload a missing item.
Same-submission retry: skip PrepareStockReceipt; retain requestKey, souvenirId, quantity and original receivedAt.
Existing receipt: requestMatches=true reuses its saved outcome; false returns request conflict without exposing receipt or changing stock.
Confirmed rollback: return storage failure. Unknown outcome: recheck the same key with MatchesRequest; a miss/error stays unknown. No new key or blind save.
Stock refresh failure after receipt confirmation: keep receipt success, currentSouvenir absent and stockRefreshSucceeded=false; reload stock. Lookup failure is not zero stock.
[Save committed or (existing receipt found and requestMatches = true)]
